title: High saturation and low brightness for physiological arousal and attention
statement:
High color saturation combined with low brightness produces the highest levels of physiological arousal, making these colors highly effective for grabbing immediate attention.

Options:
- Intense Arousal: High Saturation / Low Brightness (fits: alert banners, critical errors)
- Calming / Restful: Low Saturation / High Brightness (fits: backgrounds, empty states)
- Energetic / Happy: High Saturation / High Brightness (fits: onboarding illustrations)
appliesWhen: Applies to: notifications, gaming ui. Audience: general.

source.title: Color and emotion: effects of hue, saturation, and brightness
